conclusion: Prospective. Four source files frozen. Actual GPU resource use, predictive benefit and scientific novelty are unestablished.
hypothesis: An observed donor-support Gram improves ancestry accuracy and NLL over identity-donor and marginal outer-product controls through the same static whole-tree GNN gates.
method: Three fresh FP32 static fits share seed101 and initial H030 first moments. Exact relative first, doubled and second-moment tree messages provide support Gram gates. Independently learned kernel costs can subsequently change first moments, so this is a learned-condition comparison rather than a fixed-p intervention. Reuse frozen H025/H026 now and final selected H030 static only after it completes.
novelty_assessment: Tree OU exponential kernels, positive rerooting and second-order graph statistics are established. The exact coupling, useful biological effect and priority remain unproven. This static route does not yet fulfill a novel ordered graph-collection architecture.

protocol.effective_capacity: Allocated capacity equal. Known nonzero-column counts differ, reported in config.
protocol.first_moment_control: Reuse final minimum-NLL-selected H030 static after its run completes, with no fit dependency or warmstart.
protocol.p_parity_scope: Exact at equal cost parameters. Separate optimization can learn different first moments.

repeat_policy: Do not refit unchanged H030 static. Fit only the new identity, marginal outer and tree Gram arms,160updates each, one seed. No seed sweep, window tuning, FP64 parent matrix or dense unqualified alignment sham.
